chapter: Washington clubs, Louis Jordan and Sarah Vaughan, 1949-54
title: Wales, Scotland and Glasgow pianist John Scott Henderson
summary: A Glasgow pianist who knew of Malachi writes ahead and meets him at the station, showing him the town.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: went to Wales -- Cardiff, Wales, and some other little town in Wales. Finally, we closed the tour with a tour to Scotland, where I... I had a very nice time in Scotland.

About a week prior to going to Scotland, I got this letter... No, it wasn't. I received this letter the first week I was in England from this guy in Scotland saying that he knew I was coming to Scotland, and he would be there to greet me when we got there. Now, this is like almost a month before we were to play Scotland. And I was just delighted to know that anybody outside of Washington, D.C., or the United States for sure, would know anything about me. Anyway, this fellow's name was John Scott Henderson, and he was a pianist in Glasgow.

When we got to Glasgow, true to his word, he was there at the station. He took me to the hotel... First thing, he offered me a place to stay at his house, but I told him that reservations had already been made. So he took me to my hotel, took me around to the barber shop to get a haircut and whatever. He just stayed with me, and welcomed me to Scotland all the way.
